description: This file contains unit tests for the Ollama provider models module, testing functions for resolving API base URLs and enriching models with context windows.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Cleans up after each test by unstubbing all globals.

methods.description: Defines a test suite for Ollama provider models.
